notes.title: Upcoming Patch 2.0
notes.content:
Hello Initiates!

We bring thrilling news from the world of Trails of the Black Sun! Version 2.0 of our epic game is just around the corner, and it's packed with exciting improvements that will immerse you deeper into the universe. Here's what you can look forward to:

▚ [b]Expanded Language Support[/b]: Prepare to embark on your journey in Portuguese! We're thrilled to introduce this new language option, making the Trails of the Black Sun experience accessible to even more players worldwide.

▚ [b]Dialogue System[/b]: Get ready to encounter fascinating characters in your quests. Version 2.0 introduces the enigmatic Master Worshipper, formidable Templar Soldiers, and the Goddess Luana. Engage with them through our enhanced dialogue system, allowing you to delve deeper into the lore and uncover new secrets of the game.

▚ [b]Enhanced Gameplay Immersion[/b]: Our dialogue system doesn't just add new characters; it enriches the overall gameplay experience, unveiling hidden narratives and forging unique paths within the game.

▚ [b]Community-Driven Bug Fixes[/b]: We appreciate the dedication of our passionate community in reporting bugs. Version 2.0 addresses reported issues, ensuring a smoother and more enjoyable adventure for all players.

Stay tuned for more updates and remember to share your thoughts and experiences with us in the comments section. Happy gaming, Initiates!

- Rebel Team
